1  PETITIONER ON BAIL IN CR.NO.166/2023 REGISTERED BY  SAKALESHPURA RURAL POLICE STATION, HASSAN FOR THE
OFFENCE
P/U/S 498A, 304B R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4  OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT, PENDING ON THE FILE OF PRINCIPAL  CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C., SAKALESHPURA.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE  COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:40027  CRL.P No. 10942 of 2023  ORDER 1. Accused no.2 in Crime No.166/2023 registered by Sakaleshpura Police Station, Hassan District,
for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B, 34 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, is before this Court under Section 439 Cr.PC.
2.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

3. On the basis of the complaint dated 22.07.2023 lodged by Vishwanatha - father of deceased Nanditha, FIR in Crime No.166/2023 was registered by the police for the aforesaid offences against Somashekhar and the petitioner herein who is the mother of Somashekhar.
During the course of investigation, petitioner was arrested on 07.07.2023.
Her bail application filed before the Court of III Addl.
District
& Sessions Judge, Hassan,
in Crl. Misc. No.1262/2023 was rejected on 19.10.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition, submits that the petitioner is a lady aged about 68 years and there are no serious allegations against her in the complaint which would attract the offence NC: 2023:KHC:40027 under Section 304B IPC.

Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5.
Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

6. A reading of the complaint averments would go to show that deceased Nanditha - daughter of the complainant was married to accused no.1 and the petitioner herein is the mother of accused no.1 - Somashekhar.
Nanditha was working in HDFC Bank at Hassan.
The accused persons were allegedly ill-treating and torturing her and were forcing her to bring additional dowry.
It is also alleged that they were threatening the deceased with dire consequences.

7. A further reading of the complaint would go to show that on 21.07.2023 accused no.1 had lodged a complaint against the deceased Nanditha in Sakaleshpura Rural Police Station and the police had summoned Nanditha to the Police Station.
Thereafter, on 22.07.2023, she had committed suicide in the house of the complainant.

2 8.
No such serious allegations are made against the petitioner in the complaint which would attract the offence NC: 2023:KHC:40027 under Section 304B of IPC.
Petitioner, who is a lady aged about 68 years, is in custody from 07.07.2023.
Under the circumstances, I am of the view that the petitioner has made out a case for grant of regular bail.

Accordingly, the following order:
9.
The petition is allowed.

Sd/-
